name: Pitch with Fives
description: Pitch with Fives (Catch Five) is a Pitch variant with only one scoring five: the trump 5 (5 points). Nine points total per hand: high, low, jack, game, five. 4p partnerships, 6 cards, purge non-trumps, refill. Must follow suit. 31 to win.

overview.description: Pitch with Fives (Catch Five) is a Pitch variant with only one scoring five: the trump 5 (5 points). Nine points total per hand: high, low, jack, game, five. 4p partnerships, 6 cards, purge non-trumps, refill. Must follow suit. 31 to win.

history.origins: Original Pedro had only one scoring five (9 points). Pitch with Fives preserves this. Judd A. Schorr; Catch Five in some regions.
timeline: Variant of Pitch (Setback) in which the trump five scores 5 points; described alongside Double Pedro and Cinch in rulebooks and online.

rules.objective: First team to 31. Nine points per hand: high(1), low(1), jack(1), game(1), five(5).
rules.gameplay: 1. Bid min 2; dealer forced to bid min if all pass. Dealer can steal by equalling. 2. High bidder names trump. 3. All discard non-trumps. 4. Dealer refills to 6. 5. Play tricks. Must follow suit. 6. Trump 5 = 5 points to side that wins it.
keyRules: Only one five scores: trump 5 (5 pts).
9 points total: high, low, jack, game, five.

strategy.basic: Save trump to capture the five. Must follow suit restricts trumping.
strategy.intermediate: Purge reveals trump counts. Time the five capture.
strategy.advanced: Can start with no trump and pick up 3-5 in refill.
tips: Must follow suit - cannot save 5 by trumping if you have led suit.

scoring.description: High(1), low(1), jack(1), game(1), five(5) = 9. 31 wins.

synthesis.shortDescription: Pitch with single scoring five. Must follow suit. 31 target.
